themepack_step1_desc:
1. E ho'ā i kāu mea pāʻani ma ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i ke pihi Power.
2. Ke ho'omaka 'o Rockbox, e ho'opili i ke kaula USB i kāu kamepiula.
3. Inā koi ʻia ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka mea pāʻani, e hōʻoia i ke ʻano USB Storage i ʻike ʻia ka hāmeʻa ma ke ʻano he drive.

themepack_step2_desc: Ma muli o ka hūnā ʻana o nā ʻōnaehana hana (e like me macOS) i nā dotfiles (e like me .rockbox) ma ke ʻano paʻamau, hiki iā ʻoe ke koho i ANY folder a i ʻole ke kumu hoʻokele ma kāu mea pāʻani. E ʻimi ʻakomi mākou a hana paha i ka papa kuhikuhi .rockbox no ʻoe.

2. E koho i KEKAHI waihona ma ka mea pāʻani ma lalo nei (.rockbox, Music, Themes, a i ʻole ke kumu hoʻokele - aia kahi waihona .rockbox huna).
